full_page.content:
1950, March 4
Ifrs. 3.L. Eichhorn, R.E.
Page 2
I almost forgot to tell you that having left Detroit the convert darkies returned after plus three years - three of them instead of two. The good God had blessed them with a decidedly promising young- ster, the picture of his appreciative Daddy. ..... I hope that may offer you an example from which to draw a practical lesson. - one case in thousands. Thanks be to God.
(not signed)
